label: D2 after choosing a2, strongest on rare a2->S1 transitions (early/mid episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 and essentially only when this trial chose a2 (in_action == 2; 99.9% of activations, recall of D2&a2 = 0.999 but precision 0.28). Magnitude is dominated by rare transitions a2->S1: D2&a2&S1 holds 88% of activation mass and covers ~100% of the top quartile; common a2->S2 gives weak activations (lowest quartiles), boosted after a previous reward. Activation also depends strongly on episode time: it rises through trials 20-59 and is nearly silent after trial ~80, so adding ep_trial < 75 raises precision (dev P 0.78, R 0.54, F1 0.64, mass 0.87 vs 0.60/0.56/0.58/0.88 without it). Never fires at D1 or GO, nor on a1 trials. Uses only observed variables (the choice and reached state are inputs at D2).
